title: Co-op Reward Viewer (Beta)
description:
[h1]See what your teammates are choosing[/h1]
View your teammates' currently open card rewards in the native Slay the Spire 2 card UI. Click the card icon beside a player's name to switch views and return to your own pending reward.

[list]
[*]Exact card offers, including upgrades and enchantments.
[*]Shared cursors when viewing the same reward.
[*]Left-click a card to recommend it; native portraits show who voted.
[*]Right-click for native card inspection.
[*]Only the owner can take or skip their reward.
[/list]

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
Current development build: public-beta v0.111.0. Stable/main compatibility is pending. Install the same mod version on the host and all participating players for shared cursors and recommendations. No BaseLib or other mods required.

[h2]Platforms[/h2]
One managed DLL for macOS, Windows and Linux. Engine checks pass on Mac Apple Silicon and Intel/Rosetta. Native Windows/Linux and Steam co-op validation are still pending.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
Subscribe, let Steam download the item, enable Co-op Reward Viewer in the game's Mods menu, and restart if prompted. When testing the Workshop copy, move your manually installed RewardViewer folder out of the game's mods directory first.
changeNote: Version 0.5.2: Initial Workshop package. View open teammate card rewards, share cursors, and recommend cards using native UI.
